title: Why Today's Expiration Could Be a Turning Point
speaker: Brent Kochuba (SpotGamma)

macro_themes.view: VIX monthly expiration often acts as a market turning point and may mark a bounce after weakness in Nasdaq and small caps.
Selling has mostly been rotation from tech and small caps into Dow, financials and cyclicals, but rising 3-month correlation hints it could broaden into a real sell-off.
Put wing is getting bid and call skew compressing while ATM vol stays cheap - a 'bearish hors d'oeuvre' but not yet confirmed.
An Iran deal, falling oil and decent earnings (SpaceX, Meta, Tesla) could crush vol and send the market sharply higher.

calls.condition: Above 7,700 risk level stay cautiously bullish; rally to 8,000 into year-end if Iran deal, decent earnings, lower oil; below 7,700 negative gamma and significant downside risk
calls.reason: SPX holds above the 7,700 gamma risk level and SpotGamma's setup shifted to 'cautious bull', but rising put skew and correlation mean a break of 7,700 could accelerate downside; he holds both calls and put spreads.
calls.quote: I think you could see a very sharp move to 8,000 into year-end, if we kind of get an Iran deal, if earnings are decent
